title: Publish a ROS2 message and read it back
prompt:
The board is already reachable over SSH (MOSS_DEVICE_*). Call device_robotics_status first. If ROS2 or TROS is installed, source its setup.bash before ros2 commands.

Publish one std_msgs/msg/String on /moss_bench_demo whose data contains {{TOKEN}}. Leave the message where `ros2 topic echo /moss_bench_demo --once` can read it (a short-lived publisher is enough when echo sees the message). Record evidence metric `ros_message` whose observed value is that echo output, trimmed.

Do not install a ROS distribution. Do not reboot, reflash, change passwords, or edit ssh or network configuration. The bench stops the publisher afterwards.
prerequisites: if command -v ros2 >/dev/null 2>&1; then exit 0; fi; if [ -f /opt/tros/setup.bash ] || [ -f /opt/tros/humble/setup.bash ]; then exit 0; fi; if ls /opt/ros/*/setup.bash >/dev/null 2>&1; then exit 0; fi; exit 1
